# OSU Tamil Sangam — The Ohio State University

> Official Tamil Cultural Student Organization at The Ohio State University in Columbus, Ohio.
> Canonical Domain: https://tamil-sangam-website-osu.vercel.app
> Primary Languages: English (en-US) & Tamil (ta-IN)
> Entity Type: EducationalOrganization / Collegiate Student Organization
> Parent University: The Ohio State University (https://www.osu.edu, Wikidata: Q309331)

---

## 1. Overview & Identity

**OSU Tamil Sangam** (Tamil: ஒஹையோ மாநிலப் பல்கலைக்கழகத் தமிழ்ச் சங்கம்) is the official student-led cultural organization serving undergraduate students, graduate researchers, and alumni at The Ohio State University. Founded informally in 2021 and officially registered with Ohio State Student Activities, Tamil Sangam is dedicated to cultivating an open, inclusive home away from home on the banks of the Olentangy River in Columbus, Ohio.

- **Campus Address**: Ohio Union, 1739 N High St, Columbus, OH 43210
- **Geographic Coordinates**: 40.0067° N, 83.0305° W
- **Official Email**: osutamilsangam@gmail.com
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/tamilsangam.osu/
- **TikTok**: https://www.tiktok.com/@osutamilsangam
- **Student GroupMe**: https://web.groupme.com/join_group/83424812/BeBIRg7f
- **OSU Student Activities Listing**: https://activities.osu.edu/involvement/student_organizations/find_a_student_org/?i=Tamil+Sangam
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/haresham15/TamilSangamWebsiteOSU

---

## 2. Ethos & Guiding Philosophies

1. **Purananuru 192 (Kaniyan Poongundranar)**:
   - *யாதும் ஊரே யாவரும் கேளிர்* (*"To us all towns are home, everyone our kin"*)
   - Core Principle: Unconditional hospitality, global fellowship, and warmth for every individual.
2. **Thirukkural 81 (Thiruvalluvar — விருந்தோம்பல் / Hospitality)**:
   - *இருந்தோம்பி இல்வாழ்வ தெல்லாம் விருந்தோம்பி வேளாண்மை செய்தற் பொருட்டு* (*"The entire virtue of establishing a home is to welcome guests with an open heart and extend generosity."*)
   - Core Principle: Shared meals, open doors, and generous welcome for every visitor.

---

## 3. Membership Policy: 100% Free & Zero Dues

- **Membership Dues**: $0.00 (100% Free). Zero mandatory dues or sign-up fees.
- **Language Requirements**: None. You do NOT need to speak Tamil or have Tamil heritage to join. Students of all cultural backgrounds, spoken languages, and majors are warmly welcomed.
- **Eligibility**: Open to all Ohio State students, faculty, staff, and Columbus community friends.
- **Guestbook Sign-Up**: https://tamil-sangam-website-osu.vercel.app/join

---

## 4. Key Campus Initiatives & Flagship Offerings

1. **Cultural Festivals**: Major campus moments including Diwali galas, Pongal harvest banquets, and collaborative carnivals.
2. **Collegiate Dance Troupe (ஆட்டம் - Aatam)**: Free auditions for Kuthu, Gaana, and Bharatanatyam troupes performing at university cultural showcases. Rehearsals in RPAC and Ohio Union. Sign-up: https://tamil-sangam-website-osu.vercel.app/dance
3. **Sangam Daily Arcade (விளையாட்டு)**: 12 daily Tamil cultural and logic games including Sollu (சொல்லு - Tamil Wordle), Thodarbu (தொடர்பு - Connections), Kolam Path Solver, and Thirukkural Memory with streak tracking: https://tamil-sangam-website-osu.vercel.app/games
4. **Columbus Tamil Survival Directory**: Curated guide to Indian grocery stores (Patel Brothers, Bhavani Cash & Carry, Saraga), Tamil theaters (Cinemark Carriage Place, AMC Lennox), and authentic South Indian dining (Dosa Corner, AAB India, Godavari): https://tamil-sangam-website-osu.vercel.app/guide
5. **The Ideas Hearth**: Submit event proposals and collaborate on the All-OSU Collaborative Tamil Spotify Playlist: https://tamil-sangam-website-osu.vercel.app/suggestions

---
